We’re releasing all 211 of the tested designs and the lab data as a resource for scientists: https://t.co/zqke30UV2o

Read the full technical report: https://t.co/ikWVcFxnyP

This is exploratory work, and we’re not claiming to have produced an antivenom—for that, we’d have to test the binders within living cells, then in mice, among many other steps. But it’s an example of how Claude can concretely assist research in protein design.

17 of the 211 met the criteria for a binder. They bound to dangerous toxins produced by scorpions from Mexico, North Africa, and the Middle East (but not by a species from Brazil). https://t.co/GEizpvhlQX

Working with @citrini, we asked Claude to design proteins that bind to five scorpion toxins (covering the part of the toxin that latches onto cells).

Over the next 64 hours, Claude generated over 300,000 designs; we sent 211 to @adaptyvbio and @TwistBioscience for lab testing.

New on our Science Blog: designing protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins.

Scorpions sting about 1.2m people every year, and antivenoms are often costly or in short supply. Claude has made an early step toward finding new treatments.

https://t.co/l6LgdEqM7I

Voxtral 3 also introduces a voice agent SDK, built on LiveKit. 

Transcribe listens, a reasoning model thinks and calls tools, and Speech replies, streamed as one pipeline for natural, intelligent conversation.

With Pro Voice, we’re also rolling out professional voice adaptation. 

Record up to 30 minutes of audio to replicate your voice with extreme fidelity across every supported language. https://t.co/myTWFyVaUK

Voxtral Mini TTS 3 achieves state-of-the-art expressiveness in 35+ languages and 50+ dialects. 

Implicit instruction-following reads emotion, pace, and emphasis from the conversation.

With explicit instruction-following, tags like [emotion=sad][pace=slow] set them line by line. https://t.co/tFYchU6vo0

Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 is state-of-the-art in multilingual transcription, diarization and context-biasing. 

It detects when someone has finished speaking so agents can respond without delay. https://t.co/ULxCXinOXF
Catch up on all the news from Europe, plus what’s next at GTC Berlin: https://t.co/ct3RAbqMlz

Four cities. One clear message: Europe is building what’s next in AI.

Tomorrow, Jensen takes the stage at #NVIDIAGTC Berlin to continue the conversation. 

See you there. https://t.co/tiXhBhnYXs
